paper.title_en: Alternative LISA-TAIJI networks: polarization separation of the stochastic gravitational wave background
paper.abstract_en: Stochastic gravitational-wave backgrounds (SGWBs) provide a unique opportunity to probe both unresolved astrophysical populations and fundamental physics in the early Universe. Future space-based gravitational-wave (GW) detectors, such as LISA and TAIJI, will enable cross-correlation observations that are particularly sensitive to SGWBs and their polarization content. In this work, we investigate the capabilities of two proposed LISA-TAIJI networks, LISA-TAIJIp and LISA-TAIJIm, for detecting and discriminating tensor, vector, and scalar polarization components of isotropic SGWBs. Using the cross-correlation between the two networks, we evaluate their sensitivities and signal-to-noise ratios for SGWBs containing different combinations of polarization sectors. We find that the LISA-TAIJIm configuration, which has a larger relative inclination between the two constellations, exhibits substantially weaker polarization degeneracies and significantly improved performance in separating polarization components, particularly for tensor-vector-scalar backgrounds. Fisher-matrix forecasts for power-law SGWBs show that the two configurations yield broadly comparable constraints on spectral parameters, reflecting the different roles of component separation and parameter estimation. Our results demonstrate that large-angle LISA-TAIJI networks provide a more favorable geometry for model-independent SGWB polarization measurements.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究了与PTA（脉冲星计时阵列）相关的随机引力波背景的偏振分离，主题契合。理论深度高，方法严谨，数据新颖，值得关注。
decision.title_zh: 替代LISA-TAIJI网络：随机引力波背景的偏振分离
decision.abstract_zh: 随机引力波背景（SGWBs）为探测未解析的天体物理种群和早期宇宙的基础物理提供了独特的机会。未来的天基引力波（GW）探测器，如LISA和TAIJI，将能够实现交叉相关观测，这种观测对SGWBs及其偏振内容特别敏感。在这项工作中，我们研究了两个提议的LISA-TAIJI网络，即LISA-TAIJIp和LISA-TAIJIm，用于探测和区分各向同性SGWBs的张量、矢量和标量偏振分量的能力。利用两个网络之间的交叉相关，我们评估了它们对包含不同偏振扇区组合的SGWBs的灵敏度和信噪比。我们发现，LISA-TAIJIm配置，其两个星座之间的相对倾角较大，表现出显著更弱的偏振简并性，并且在分离偏振分量方面性能显著提高，特别是对于张量-矢量-标量背景。针对幂律SGWBs的Fisher矩阵预测表明，两种配置在光谱参数约束上大致相当，反映了分量分离和参数估计的不同作用。我们的结果表明，大角度LISA-TAIJI网络为模型无关的SGWBs偏振测量提供了更有利的几何形状。
